maddeler.e:
أحتضن (form VIII)
# أَحْتَضِنُ (ʔaḥtaḍinu) /ʔaħ.ta.dˤi.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَضَنَ (iḥtaḍana)
# أُحْتَضَنُ (ʔuḥtaḍanu) /ʔuħ.ta.dˤa.nu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَضَنَ (iḥtaḍana)
# أَحْتَضِنَ (ʔaḥtaḍina) /ʔaħ.ta.dˤi.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَضَنَ (iḥtaḍana)
# أُحْتَضَنَ (ʔuḥtaḍana) /ʔuħ.ta
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
